subject: Shiny Server - Disconnects when page is reloaded

messages.author: d1c96737497c2d62
messages.subject: Shiny Server - Disconnects when page is reloaded
parts:
I have a pretty extensive Shiny App built that runs very well locally, but is having issues when deployed to Shiny Server. When I initially start the server, the app will run great. However, if the page is refreshed or if the app is exited and then reloaded within one minute, I start getting disconnected from the server. If I exit the app and give it a couple minutes before bringing it up again, then the app seems to run fine with no disconnects.

I've checked all the log files, but don't see any errors. They only show that shiny-server is turning on and off.
